# Martin Tsang

> Software engineer in Toronto building production web platforms across booking, legal, and AI domains. Five years shipping full-stack systems for startups and small businesses across North America and Hong Kong, from Spring Boot backends on Kubernetes to React frontends. Available for select freelance work.

The site is one page. Each section below is an anchor on https://martintsang.vercel.app/.

## Sections

- [About](https://martintsang.vercel.app/#about): background, focus, and current work.
- [Recent projects](https://martintsang.vercel.app/#projects): GoPlace, WP Legal & Notary Public, Help Me Clean, and Jomud, with role, year, highlights, and stack.
- [Career](https://martintsang.vercel.app/#experiences): roles at Asynk, Ace Innovation Limited, Apoidea, and P L Technology Limited.
- [Tech stack](https://martintsang.vercel.app/#skills): frontend, backend, databases, cloud and DevOps, and tooling.
- [Contact](https://martintsang.vercel.app/#contact): email, GitHub, and LinkedIn.

## Projects

- [GoPlace](https://booking.goplace.com): Lead Engineer, 2024 – Present. Multi-tenant booking platform for spas and wellness studios. Spring Boot, Java 21, PostgreSQL, React, Vite, AWS EKS, Flyway.
- [WP Legal & Notary Public](https://wplegal.ca): Full-Stack Developer, 2024. Multi-language marketing site for a Toronto legal and notary firm. Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, next-intl, Resend, Vercel.
- [Help Me Clean](https://helpmeclean.ca): Full-Stack Developer, 2024. Marketing site for a GTA cleaning company serving medical, industrial, and food-processing facilities. Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, PDFKit, next-intl, Resend.
- [Jomud](https://jomud.io): Founding Engineer, 2023. AI-powered job search platform; built the resume builder tool that boosted ATS scan success by 30%. Next.js, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, AWS, TypeScript.
